mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by > 0.1pp over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and federal funds rate indicate a deteriorating economic outlook and aggressive policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by housing starts above 900 thousand units, the S&P 500 typically underperforms due to valuation pressures and policy tightening expectations over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 900 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by > 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that often triggers Fed rate cuts, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) and fall in housing starts (HOUST) indicates shifting consumption patterns that reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND HOUST falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in CPI and federal funds rate signal a monetary tightening cycle that pressures corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.
